name: onentree-desafio-fullstack
description: OnEntree - Sistema de gerenciamento de ingressos e locais de eventos

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm run build:be && npm run build:fe
scripts.lint: npm run lint:fe && npm run lint:be
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:fe && npm run typecheck:be
scripts.test: npm run test:be && npm run test:fe
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm --prefix backend exec prisma migrate dev
